aggregation.group_unit: one recorded cell; five cells per N/mode
aggregation.paired_difference: enabled minus disabled for matching N and pair_index before aggregation
aggregation.phase_summary: median/min/max across five per-cell phase medians; samples not pooled
aggregation.phase_sample_scope: available measurements on accepted writer returns; refused pre-body attempts have no measurement
aggregation.csv_phase_min_max: minimum/maximum measured invocation sample within that cell
aggregation.waiting_connection_time: sum of production RETRY_SCHEDULED to RETRY_READY durations; connection-ms
aggregation.actual_wait_duration: sum of observed waiter-call intervals; ms
aggregation.rounding: CSV/manifest retain numeric precision; report rounds to three decimals

integrity.verification_scope: offline reconciliation of stored live post-drain verification; no new database queries

claim_limitations: Experimental bound 8, max_attempts 8 and fixed 0.005-second delays are not production defaults or optimality selections.
Five recorded repetitions per N/mode support descriptive summaries only; no statistical significance or equivalence.
Only this matrix UUID and recorded cohort contribute to aggregates; smoke, warmup and cumulative snapshots are excluded.
Finite retained-lane CREATE work combines retry recovery with pacing of later fresh requests.
Higher eventual completion is not higher protected writer or database capacity.
Retry retains existing synchronous threads/connections; it does not increase configured connection count.
IDLE evidence is sampled at wait boundaries; no continuous server, CPU, scheduler or pool claim.
Measured phases overlap; missing and non-measured phase values are not zero.
One source, fixture, topology and fixed schedule; no PAY/hot-key/open-loop/deployment generalization.
No new live native/semantic-failure injection, Stage 4E authority, hard deadline or fairness guarantee.
Rate Limiter, jitter, queue, pool and async scheduling are not selected or ruled out permanently.
Archive is local and unpublished; publication requires explicit authorization.
next_architecture_question: Is retained synchronous thread/connection pressure acceptable for the intended caller, or is a separately authorized architecture/policy decision needed?

compact_results.content: one scalar-only row per recorded cell; no request/attempt/wait arrays
